warns: TRACKER.md validation FAILED at session start — injects a LOUD additionalContext envelope naming the failing checks + 'do NOT claim epic/sprint state from memory; reconcile first' (the tracker may be lying about state)
allows: PASS → one-line VALID confirmation + start-of-work reminder (consult TRACKER.md before meaningful work; TRACKER.md outranks memory)
validator runner error / TRACKER.md absent → brief fail-open note, never blocks
entries.pre_check: On SessionStart: run scripts/trackers/validate.js --json (rooted at CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, stale-worktree-safe G-3); emit SessionStart additionalContext with the tracker validity verdict so an agent cannot begin work unaware the source-of-truth tracker is red.
entries.note: Enforced-tracker system §28.2 Start-of-Work. Hard counterpart to the procedural 'consult TRACKER.md' step the 4 live modes carry. Fail-open: makes tracker state impossible to MISS, does not trap the session (the hard gate is /scan:full + the Stop hook). E-TRACKER-001.
